title: Ghurklasian Translation
description: A Ghurklasian translation for Minecraft made by the creator of Ghurklas
body:
This texture pack is the translation for Minecraft made by the creator of Ghurklas, the texture pack only contains some basic UI and every blocks for now, if you have any suggestions or want to help, contact us on our community server

To use the pack, put it in your ```ressourcepacks``` folder, turn it on in your settings, then go to the language menu and select ```Ghurklasene (Ghurklas)```


_This texture pack only contains the translations, shader or textures shown in the description or icon will not be given with the pack_
